name: nous
description: Nous Research provider module: the OpenAI-compatible inference API (POST /v1/chat/completions, Bearer API key billed against account credits) with a 402-model live catalog, tier-mapped onto models taken from that catalog, with cloud-to-local (Ollama) graceful degradation.

features.desc: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions chat with Bearer auth and typed output validation.

LOW routes to inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash, MED to qwen/qwen3.7-flash, HIGH to anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 and MAX to openai/gpt-6-astra-fast - every id VERIFIED SERVABLE against the endpoint's chat path (HTTP 402 = accepted, 400 = unknown model) rather than transcribed from the docs or the wider /v1/models listing (issue #1559).
Provider-specific: the API key is a required Bearer credential (requires_key=true), stored in Vault secret/shared-services/nous and mirrored to GSM, never in code, logs or git.
Provider-specific: usage bills against Nous account credits (plans/top-ups declared in gateway/finops/provider-credits.yaml) rather than post-paid metered USD.
Cloud-to-local fallback to the keyless local Ollama hop when the primary is unavailable.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #1559) for the registered `nous` provider adapter. Written from Nous Research's published API contract (https://portal.nousresearch.com/api-docs) - no source file was copied, and no third-party code is vendored. The `hermes` module entry is a separate, unchanged declaration for the local Ollama-compatible hop.
